prediction_clock: UTC 30-second grid; select the last applied event at or before each grid instant, never exchange timestamp

label.quote: last causally applied quote at or before due_at; require valid two-sided midpoint, bridged book, depth <= 2000ms, trades <= 3000ms and spread <= 20bps at due_at; a later invalid quote cannot be replaced by an earlier quote; no quote after due_at
label.invalid: due_at reached without a sufficiently fresh synchronized quality-gated quote; never backfill

s1_score: 0.7 * signed_aggressor_qty_ratio_30s + 0.3 * (microprice-midpoint)/spread; unitless raw score, not a probability or expected return

chronological_split.status: requires reviewed fixed UTC start/end and adequate captured sessions; the diagnostic runner does not select models

selection_metrics: calibration only after a separately trained/calibrated model exists
rejection_criteria: invalid ordering or failed capture hashes
validation direction agreement no better than fixed references at common timestamps
unreviewed cost, fill or risk assumptions
final-test tuning or repeated final-test use
economics: prediction diagnostics only; no fees, paper fills, PnL, winner or profitability claims until a separately validated shared conservative paper-fill/risk/ledger core
